## Type

- [ ] New paper / entry
- [ ] Chapter prose update (TL;DR, mechanism, debates, open problems)

## Checklist

- [ ] If adding a paper: primary-source URL (arXiv / OpenReview / ACL Anthology / official blog) ✅
- [ ] If adding a paper: annotation says *why it matters for the chapter*, ≤ 40 words ✅
- [ ] If adding a paper: open-vs-closed flag is present and honest ✅
- [ ] Scope check: not a CoT prompt-engineering recipe / not a pure formal theorem (sister list) / not a jailbreak ✅
- [ ] No closed-model marketing claims laundered as established facts ✅
- [ ] `python scripts/verify_citations.py` passes on touched files (or N/A) ✅
